title: Interactive XR Showcase
description: Fully interactive Three.js point cloud experience featuring Meta Quest 3 and Vision Pro with morphing animations and immersive navigation.

title: VR Vestibular Rehabilitation
description: Developed a high-fidelity VR vestibular rehabilitation system simulating equine-assisted therapy with 5Hz real-time biomechanical tracking, WebSocket streaming, and REST logging.

title: Forklift VR Simulator
description: Engineered a VR forklift training simulator with realistic physics and collision detection. Integrated task scoring and safety evaluation mechanisms.

title: 3D Product Configurator with AI Reviewer
description: Engineered an interactive 3D product configurator in Unity. Built a smart submesh texture routing engine to prevent dual-mesh wrapping, integrated real-time upload/download progress sliders, and designed an AI sentiment analysis panel powered by Gemini API featuring cubic-eased score countups and selectable custom color animation sweeps.
